title.zh: Bitcoin and Ethereum race quantum clock as U.S. backs $300 million hardware push
title.en: Bitcoin and Ethereum race quantum clock as U.S. backs $300 million hardware push

current_state.zh: The U.S. government is funding a $300 million quantum computing hardware initiative, intensifying the race for Bitcoin and Ethereum to implement quantum-resistant cryptography before their security is compromised.
current_state.en: The U.S. government is funding a $300 million quantum computing hardware initiative, intensifying the race for Bitcoin and Ethereum to implement quantum-resistant cryptography before their security is compromised.
